gaps.sentence: Let's start ___ — the first version had too many errors.

gaps.sentence: I can't figure ___ how this app works.
You go ahead; I'll catch ___ with you later.
gaps.explanation: catch up (with) = reach the same point/level as somebody.

gaps.sentence: It took him weeks to get ___ the flu.
gaps.explanation: get over an illness/upset = recover from it.

gaps.sentence: We saw our guests ___ at the station.
gaps.explanation: see somebody off = go with a traveller to say goodbye.

gaps.sentence: It's hard to keep ___ with the latest slang.
gaps.explanation: keep up with = stay level with somebody/something changing.

gaps.sentence: They put ___ the meeting until everyone could attend.
The film didn't live up ___ my expectations.
gaps.explanation: live up TO something = be as good as expected.
